    3 · Video clips on your shared drive (optional)
    
    
    Add a link for each full-motion clip (Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, Dropbox, the competition's video platform…). They appear as a clickable list in the Detailed report, and each screen grab can link to the clip it was taken from. Before sending, make sure every link is shared so the TO / DDO / Judicial Officer can open it, and stays live until any hearing or appeal is over.
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
  
    

  
    
    
    4 · Screen grabs (optional)
    
    
    Full-colour images are embedded at their original resolution. They go in the Detailed report box below your narrative while there is room, then on continuation pages, each numbered with its caption. JPG and PNG are used as-is; other formats are converted losslessly.
